TrainableDef.label: trunk blast
TrainableDef.description: Command the animal to blast water from its trunk. The spray knocks back and staggers anyone it hits, and puts out fires. Once trained, the animal will only blast when commanded.

TrainableDef.label: trunk throw
TrainableDef.description: Command the animal to pick up a nearby chunk with its trunk and hurl it at a target. Once trained, the animal will only throw when commanded.

TrainableDef.label: detonate
TrainableDef.description: Command the animal to run at a target and burst. The animal will not survive. Once trained, the animal will only detonate when commanded.

TrainableDef.label: gnaw
TrainableDef.description: Command the animal to gnaw on a wooden structure, damaging it and feeding itself.

TrainableDef.label: fire burst
TrainableDef.description: Command the animal to spray burning fuel in all directions. Once trained, the animal will only burst when commanded.

TrainableDef.label: belly slide
TrainableDef.description: Command the animal to flop onto its belly and slide quickly to a nearby spot.

TrainableDef.label: charge
TrainableDef.description: Command the animal to barrel into a target, battering and knocking back nearby enemies. Once trained, the animal will only charge when commanded.

TrainableDef.label: regenerate
TrainableDef.description: Teach the animal to trigger a burst of rapid healing. Once trained, it will also do this on its own when badly hurt.

TrainableDef.label: hidden dragon
TrainableDef.description: Teach the cat to vanish from sight until it strikes. Once trained, it will also do this on its own before pouncing.
